Class ImportExportDocumentsFlowController

public without sharing class ImportExportDocumentsFlowController

Apex controller for the Import/Export Documents Flow. Provides invocable methods to import and export CSV files from/to Google Firestore for menu items and customizations. Supports sandbox and production environments with email delivery of exported files and transaction logging.

Methods

public static String exportCustomizations(
  String venueId,
  FirestoreService.FirestoreAccessToken accessToken,
  String sendToEmail
)

Exports customizations from Firestore to a CSV file. Fetches all documents from the venue's customizations collection with pagination, generates a CSV with customization and option details, optionally emails it, and stores it linked to a TransactionLog__c record.

Parameters:
    venueId – The Firestore venue identifier
    accessToken – The Firestore access token for authentication
    sendToEmail – Optional email address to send the exported CSV to

Returns:
    String: A result message with export counts, email status, and download URL

Since:
    04/19/2021

public static String exportItems(
  String venueId,
  FirestoreService.FirestoreAccessToken accessToken,
  String sendToEmail
)

Exports menu items from Firestore to a CSV file. Fetches all documents from the venue's menu-items collection with pagination, generates a CSV, optionally emails it, and stores it as a ContentVersion linked to a TransactionLog__c record.

Parameters:
    venueId – The Firestore venue identifier
    accessToken – The Firestore access token for authentication
    sendToEmail – Optional email address to send the exported CSV to

Returns:
    String: A result message with export count, email status, and download URL

public static String importCustomizations(
  String venueId,
  String versionId,
  FirestoreService.FirestoreAccessToken accessToken
)

Imports customizations from a CSV file into Firestore. Reads the file from a ContentVersion record, groups rows by customization (using id + name as a hash), and creates or patches documents in the venue's customizations collection with their associated options array.

Parameters:
    venueId – The Firestore venue identifier
    versionId – The ContentVersion Id of the uploaded CSV file
    accessToken – The Firestore access token for authentication

Returns:
    String: A result message summarizing successes, errors, and governor limit warnings

Since:
    04/19/2021

@InvocableMethod(category='BlazeBite' description='Imports or exports Firestore documents as/from CSV files' label='Import/Export Documents' callout=true)
public static List<String> importExportDocuments(List<ImportExportDocumentsFlowController.ImportExportOptions> options)

Routes import/export requests to the appropriate handler method based on the provided options. Initializes a Firestore access token for the target environment and delegates to importItems(), exportItems(), importCustomizations(), or exportCustomizations().

Parameters:
    options – List of ImportExportOptions containing the action, document type, environment, and venue details

Returns:
    String[]: List containing a single result message describing the outcome

public static String importItems(
  String venueId,
  String versionId,
  FirestoreService.FirestoreAccessToken accessToken
)

Imports menu items from a CSV file into Firestore. Reads the file from a ContentVersion record, parses each row, and creates or patches documents in the venue's menu-items collection. Supports fields: name, id, description, price, defaultTax, taxPct, path.

Parameters:
    venueId – The Firestore venue identifier
    versionId – The ContentVersion Id of the uploaded CSV file
    accessToken – The Firestore access token for authentication

Returns:
    String: A result message summarizing successes, errors, and governor limit warnings

private static ImportExportDocumentsFlowController.DocumentRequest saveCustomization(
  String venueId,
  FirestoreService.FirestoreAccessToken accessToken,
  ImportExportDocumentsFlowController.DocumentRequest documentReq
)

Saves a single customization document to Firestore. Creates a new document if no documentId is provided, otherwise patches the existing document with the specified field mask.

Parameters:
    venueId – The Firestore venue identifier
    accessToken – The Firestore access token for authentication
    documentReq – The DocumentRequest containing the document Id, JSON body, and fields to update

Returns:
    DocumentRequest: The same request object updated with the operation result

Since:
    04/19/2021
